notes.title: The storm blows…. Castaway Paradise on to Nintendo Switch ™
notes.notes:
“Your adventure starts when you get stranded on a tropical island. This is your island, your adventure! Do whatever you like! It's the ultimate Sandbox sim!” 

With these words, we want to start our announcement and we are more than happy to let you know that this spring it will finally happen!

Let all your friends know, [b]Castaway Paradise[/b] will be released on [b]Nintendo Switch ™[/b]! We know a lot of you were waiting to read this news and we count on you to help us spread the word!

[b][h3]Attention! Attention![/h3][/b]
You don't want to miss any news during our journey to the [b]Nintendo Switch ™[/b] world and even the final release date? 
Join the [url=http://bit.ly/39kQQsM]💌Release Radar🚨[/url] and be always up to date with us!

[b][h3]OH you´re a Content Creator?[/h3][/b]
[b]Awesome! [/b]
Want to make some videos for your followers? Even better!
Let us know with a [url=http://bit.ly/2M91Alj]key request[/url] and be part of our creative minds!

Be one of the first on the Nintendo Switch ™ to conquer the island and make it yours!

notes.title: Castaway Paradise Version 3.0 beta available now! [update]
notes.notes:
Today we're happy to anounce version 3.0 beta is available for everyone!

Castaway Paradise v3 adds a new user interface, lots of bug fixes, controller support and more. When you start the game you now have the option to play either v2 or v3. 

At this moment v3 only supports controllers. So if you do not have a controller you can continue to play v2. If you do have a controller, please enjoy the new experience!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/304950][/url]

[Update] We have fixed a bug that prevented people from accessing Version 3.0 You can now all play version 3.0!

notes.title: Controller Support coming soon
notes.notes:
We know you’ve been asking for it….

[h1]Console Release[/h1]
Castaway Paradise is soon going to be released on Xbox One and Playstation™4 – that’s great news if you have one of those consoles, but what if you only play on PC? We’ll tell you: it’s still good news because it means that [b]full controller support[/b] is going to be added to the PC version of Castaway Paradise! Expect the console release and Steam update on July 31.

https://youtu.be/kEv6jWMyK78 

[h1]Celebration Discount[/h1]
But wait, there’s more! To celebrate the console release, we will also be putting the Steam version of Castaway Paradise on sale. If you’ve been waiting for an opportunity to get a holiday bargain, now’s your chance!

It’s summer and time to relax… hit the beach in Castaway Paradise!

notes.notes:
As we are getting ready for the Castaway Paradise Version 3.0 beta, we would like to let you all know we have a little surprise for you. July will be a very special month for Castaway fans, as we are going to release the first companion Castaway game: Castaway Home Designer.

Castaway Home Designer is the ultimate home decorating simulation. You get to decorate dozens of homes with more than 1000+ pieces of furniture. Each house will be rated on your design skills, so you should definitely bring your A game. 

Castaway Home Designer will launch in July. Castaway Paradise Version 3.0  beta will launch around the same time, and adds many features you requested like Controller support and a better interface.

notes.title: Version 3.0 update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8661635/8719c5c517a2406532ae5f316e869a996697fe9d.png[/img]

Hello Castaway players,

A few months ago we announced Castaway Paradise 3.0 a complete overhaul of the game's controls, user interface and presentation. We estimated it would be live at the end of 2016, we failed to deliver on that estimation. Here is why.

The reason we are developing Castaway Paradise version 3.0 is to make the game enjoyable for a lot of players. Some users have been complaining about control issues and the sometimes touch screen-esque nature of the interface. 

Version 3.0 fixes this by making the controls work with standard Xbox-layout controllers. Instead of the player following your mouse they will now be directly controlled by the analogue stick. A bigger change has happened to the user interface. It's been completely rewritten and redesigned. With version 3.0 you can comfortably play the game on a touch screen, with a controller or with a mouse and keyboard. 

These changes weren't just made for you steam players. Version 3.0 will mean Castaway Paradise will be a console game as well. A Xbox One and PS4 version are on their way.

The reason for the delay of version 3.0 is that we want to unify the experience on all platforms. This is taking longer than we expected, but will have massive benefits to you steam users. As version 3.0 will be a multi platform release you can expect a much more polished experience than before. Instead of making a separate console release and abandoning the steam version we choose to make version 3.0.

Castaway Paradise version 3.0 is still in development. It will be awesome.

Check out this new screenshot of the dialogue system in version 3.0

notes.title: Announcing v3.0
notes.notes:
Hello Castaway players,

today we're announcing the biggest update to Castaway Paradise ever! Version 3.0 will be released later this year and will completely transform the way you play Castaway Paradise!

During the upcoming weeks we will be giving you bit of information about all the new things coming to the game. So be sure to check back soon or follow us on Facebook.

The first big feature I'd like to talk about is full controller support! Castaway Paradise v3.0 has been redesigned with controllers in mind. Players will have complete control over their character for the first time. Instead of clicking on bubbles to perform certain actions you will be able to just simply hit a button. This will improve the responsiveness of the game tremendously.

In order to accommodate controller support we had to  completely redesign the user interface of the game. This means that every menu, every button, every piece of text has been rebuild from the ground up. This also includes 4K ready graphics. It's clear that we're now dealing with a true desktop class game here.

Please check out the screenshot of the new catalogue from Castaway Paradise v3.0:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8661635/264300990c5858b16722654c8b40df184e8eb09e.png[/img]

We're also looking for people who want to help with the translation of Castaway Paradise into other languages. Please take a look here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScDN121StWGBzNFx1_fddwKM0D3EtL6MU3ZV6hCb_u4Ch837A/viewform 

Let us know what you think about v3.0!

notes.title: UPDATE TIME!
notes.notes:
Hi Paradise dwellers!

We've got some great news for you today. A new update is now available for Castaway Paradise. This update fixes some smaller bugs and introduces some awesome new features.

The biggest change to the game is the ability to move your bed! That's right, you can now pick-up, rotate and place your bed anywhere you like. In the next update we'll introduce all kinds of new beds you can purchase from the catalogue and shop.

We've also added 7 more levels for you to gain, so keep on levelling! Talking about levelling; the amount of XP needed for levels 15 and up has decreased. This makes the game less grindy. It might cause some players to immediately skip a level or two, so please don't be confused when that happens.

See you next time!

notes.title: Meet the new villager: Stevie!
notes.notes:
I hope you are all enjoying your time on Castaway Paradise. To thank all of you for playing we're releasing a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/388780]free new DLC pack[/url]. This pack unlocks a completely new villager called Stevie!

She is a nature ranger and loves the outdoors. She is not a big fan of creepy crawlers and is convinced that eating vegetables is hurting the veggies. On a diet made up from only fruit (because fruit can't feel a thing) she makes YOU her deputy. Helping her with all different types of chores, like decorating her tent and making sure Victoria doesn't eat all the flower bulbs, a whole new adventure starts on Castaway Paradise! This sassy and somewhat strange Platypus has a strong opinion on the other villagers.

Stevie is available to download from the Steam store. It's a FREE download.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304950]Buy Castaway Paradise today![/url]

notes.title: UPDATES July 1st
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

June was an amazing month for Castaway Paradise. A lot of players bought the game during the Summer Sale, and have become active members of our little community. We've also added and changed lots of things to the game!

Early June we released the first of many FREE DLC packs, the China Theme pack. It includes dozens of exclusive items you can only get here on Steam. Be sure to download it if you haven't already.

Later in the month Castaway Paradise celebrated the women's world cup soccer with another FREE DLC pack. Stolen Couch Games wants to support women's soccer by giving you all free items and clothing!

Besides free DLC packs Castaway Paradise has gotten numerous updates throughout the month to fix issues and give you all a better Castaway experience. Many requested features have been put in the game and we're planning a lot more changes.

So what's in store for July, you ask? Well A LOT!

Ronimo Games is the amazing developer of one of our favourite games: Awesomenauts. We're teaming up to bring you the exclusive Awesomenauts DLC pack! It includes 6 masks of some of the most popular 'Nauts from the popular MOBA. Best of all: the Awesomenauts DLC pack will be completely FREE!

July will also be the month we will welcome a new villager to the island. Get ready to meet .....! We're keeping her name secret for now :). This new villager will be downloadable for FREE. She will come with dozens of new quests and lots of chit chats. So be sure to say hello to her later this month.

That's all for today. Be sure to let your friends know that you like Castaway Paradise and that they should buy the game as well. Also, we would appreciate you leaving a review for our little game. If you want to stay up to date about all the new content you can like us on Facebook: www.Facebook.com/CastawayParadise

notes.title: LAUNCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
Castaway Paradise has launched onto Steam! Get ready to play the COMPLETE edition of Castaway Paradise!

People have been asking how this version is different to our mobile version. Biggest changes to the premium model:
- You pay once for the game. There are no micro transactions in the game.
- There is no second (hard) currency. You can't buy currency.
- Timers are shorter! 
- All content packs can be unlocked in the game for free.
- You unlock VIP status when you reach level 15. This will grant you even more free stuff.

What we tried to do with this version is to make the best possible version of Castaway Paradise. Everything that has been bothering players has been fixed with this version. It's truly the Complete Edition of Castaway Paradise.

Some other changes we made with the launch update:
- Controls have been vastly improved.
- Some timers have been shortened.
- Many many more tweaks to make the game even better.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.6244 - Giving the control to the players
notes.notes:
Hi all, here is another update for Castaway Paradise! This update focusses on controls, among other things. Check out the list of changes below:


- Some prices will be more expensive (items, puzzle pieces etc).
- GUI floaters will be better. Buttons won't jump around that much.
- Timer indicator will be less wide.
- Controls will be listed in the settings menu.
- Pop-up added with: "You don't have enough gems"
- Equipment can be equiped by pressing 1-9 on the keyboard.

Please give us your feedback on these changes. We'd love to hear what's wrong about the game, so that we can fix it.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.6226 - Delivering them premium feels
notes.notes:
Guess what, another update! We keep on delivering them premium feels. Here is the list: 

- Multiple save file support!
- Pearls have been removed from the game. All your pearls have been converted into Gems.
- Keyboard controls are now less buggy.
- The ability to speed-up timers have been removed. Please let us know what you think about this.

Enjoy the game! If you like it don't forget to leave a review.

notes.title: Update 1.6218 - So many new features!
notes.notes:
We want to thank all our players for their amazing feedback. We've made a lot of tweaks to Castaway Paradise to make it a better experience. Here is the list:

- Zoom in and out using the scroll wheel.
- Control your character with the keyboard ("WASD" to move, "Space" to use your equipment, "E" to switch equipment to suggested equipment, "SHIFT" to run).
- Change the resolution of the game!
- Fastest quality mode has been added to improve framerates for some users.
- Disable and enable vertical sync.
- Windowed mode added.
- Bugs and fish now spawn more frequently.
- Some timers are shorter.
- When you have your move tool open you can now start conversations.
- Some textual changes (no more mentions of the word "Tap").
- Some Start of Game messages will be removed.
- "Last chance" for fishing removed.

- We added the Mother's Day event!

Enjoy the game! If you like it don't forget to leave a review.
